extra_examples.en: Copy the word into your book.
extra_examples.zh: 把这个单词抄到你的本子上。

teaching.student_prompt: 找找原画和临摹画哪里一样，再说 copy。
teaching.note: 原创 KET 课堂例句；先读单词与例句，再学习构词或常用搭配。

word_study.explanation_zh: copy 整体记，表示“照着做一份”。加 -er 成为 copier 时，y 要变成 i；还可和 photo 组成 photocopy。

family.connection_zh: copy 去 y，换成 i，再加 -er；这里 -er 表示机器。

example.en: The copier is next to the desk.

challenge.prompt_zh: copy 变成 copier 时，哪个字母变了？

images.alt: 孩子用彩铅照着原图，在另一张纸上临摹同样的橙色风筝。
images.caption: Please copy this picture.
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one classroom vocabulary photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners; landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024.
Style: beautiful playful realistic editorial photography, bright natural daylight, rich plausible colours, real materials and textures, correct anatomy, uncluttered composition, clear main subject for a large projector.
Constraints: no embedded text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart. All people fictional, children fully clothed in ordinary appropriate clothes. Generous margins, no clipped main subject, safe friendly scenes.
Primary request: Over-the-shoulder close view of a fully clothed child carefully copying a simple hand-drawn orange kite picture onto a second sheet of white paper with a coloured pencil. The original kite drawing and a near-complete matching copy are visible side by side, two separate sheets, no writing on either. Natural hand anatomy, focus on the act of making the same drawing again in a bright classroom.
